تمتزجوا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَزِجُوا (tamtazijū) /tam.ta.zi.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# تُمْتَزَجُوا (tumtazajū) /tum.ta.za.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
